releases.displayName: The Well-Stocked Brewery Update is Out Now!

items.text: The Well-Stocked Brewery Update is live! You asked for better storage management, so this update is all about keeping your stock under control: clearer storage, smarter shopping and fewer clicks between brewing and selling.
Decide exactly what each pallet or shelf holds: capped or uncapped beer, empty crates or a specific beer style.
A new app lists everything in your warehouse and at the pickup point, so you can check your stock at a glance.
The shop now shows how many of each item you already own. Ingredients used in your active mixer recipe and items meant for automated production are marked as well, so you always know what to restock.
Fulfill contracts in batches through the computer and decline beer festivals you don't want to join. Festivals now only appear for beers you have already brewed.
Added filters for beers placed on pallets and shelves.
Added a Stock Overview app that lists the items in your warehouse.
The shop now shows how many of each item you own.
Ingredients used in the active mixer recipe are now marked.
Machines and ingredients meant for automated production are now marked.
The staff panel now explains that a new employee appears only after being assigned to a machine.
The delivery pickup point is now bigger.
You can now change the recipe in the recipe preview panel while using a vat.
You can now decline a beer festival in the Contracts tab.
Beer festivals now only appear for beers you have already brewed.
You can now drain water from the automatic vat.
You can now fulfill contracts in batches through the computer.
Fixed an employee at the large capping machine putting down the same crate over and over.
Fixed a rare bug where fermentation did not move on to the temperature control stage.
Fixed a rare sudden temperature spike while boiling hops to 100°C.
Fixed a rare bug that prevented pouring beer back into the tank.
Fixed a rare bug that blocked an empty machine.
Fixed a rare bug that prevented placing machines.
Fixed occasional problems with saving settings.
Fixed incorrect resale and scrap prices for unused machines (when using the trash bin or the pickup point).
Fixed 50 L kegs turning into 20 L kegs.
Fixed how employee wages are calculated.
Jump in, try the new tools and let us know how they work in your brewery. Share your feedback on our Discord or in the Steam discussions.
Cheers! 🍻
Beer Manufacture Simulator Team

releases.displayName: The Bigger, Better Brewery Update Is Now Available!

items.text: The vats are full, the production lines are polished, and the Bigger, Better Brewery Update is officially LIVE! Thank you for your patience and incredible support. It's time to step back into the brewery and take your beer empire to entirely new heights.

notes.title: Here is everything fresh and bubbling in today's update

items.text: New beer style - expand your portfolio with brand-new brewing possibilities!
New ingredients - get creative and craft unique, mouth-watering flavor profiles.
Upgraded automated machines - now featuring a larger crate capacity to keep your production flowing smoother than ever.
New radio tracks - fresh tunes to vibe to while you manage your factory floor.
Increased max level - push your brewing skills and business limits even further.
New high-level contracts - take on massive orders for equally massive rewards!
Custom recipe deletion - you can finally clear out those failed experiments and organize your recipe book.
New achievements & diplomas - prove your true mastery and decorate your office walls.
Varied employee parameters - manage a much more dynamic workforce with unique traits and skills.

notes.title: Grab a Cold One and a Sweet Deal! 💸

notes.title: Today is Friday, the end of the work week, but for us, it means something completely different... today we have a special visit!

items.text: Once again, thank you so much for all the feedback, opinions, and ideas you have given us since the release of the demo 🤝 if you haven't done so yet or have something else in mind, please share it with us!

Our connoisseur, Connoisseur Mietek, has arrived in the Demo version - a unique, extraordinary personality, an expert is an understatement, a man who can smell a poorly brewed beer from a mile away, who can spot a loose cap with his eagle eyes - so it's time to roll up your sleeves even more and prepare for our connoisseur's visit!
Legend has it that under the influence of Connoisseur Mietek's gaze, even bottles stand upright - there is no chance of them lying on their sides.
Connoisseur Mietek and other features are already available in the demo version in Patch 1.0.2, which you can download now!

🧔 Connoisseur Mietek - bring him the beer he asks for, and he’ll reward you generously. Don’t worry though - he’ll be happy with any beer you give him! (Mietek can be found in the room unlocked after completing the tutorial)
⚙️ Machine Relocation - you can now move already built machines around your workshop.
🌡️ Added a new temperature control minigame during the brewing process - check the encyclopedia to see what it’s all about!
💾 Autosave - the game now automatically saves your progress every few minutes.
🎥 Added a new video to the encyclopedia.
🍺 Tutorial - while pouring beer in the tutorial, you can now pick up bottles even if you drop them.
🗑️ Confirmation Prompts - added confirmation messages when discarding items into the trash or removing beer from a machine.
🎉 Notifications - new notifications for leveling up and receiving rewards from contracts.
📊 Added display of ingredient parameters in the beer mixer (TAB).
🍻 Changed the default key used to drink beer to R.
💧 Added a pouring effect to the beer tap.
🖥️ Fixed display issues on various screen resolutions.
🧩 Fixed issues with taking items out of machine slots - it’s now easier to remove items such as bottles.
🍾 Fixed animation glitches during capping and labeling.
🛠️ Fixed rare cases where performing a tutorial step too quickly could block progress.
🔧 Secured a case where UI elements could remain visible after closing certain panels.
⚗️ Increased the yeast bag capacity to 18, making them sufficient for 75-liter vats.
If you have any questions or would like to chat with other members of our community, hop on over to our Discord! 👇
Have fun!
Beer Manufacture Simulator Team

items.text: A new update is now live!
New Patch is available to download.
This update focuses on fixing several issues reported by the community and improving overall gameplay stability.
Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze when using the crate table
Fixed issues where UI panels for tables and machines could get stuck, and secured cases where they prevented the pause menu from opening
Fixed a bug where bottles disappeared from crates after placing them on pallets
Fixed a bug where a glass could remain stuck under the tap
Fixed a bug where high-level festival contracts appeared too early
Fixed a bug preventing players from exiting the thermometer view
The “Trash Container” upgrade has been moved higher in the upgrades tab; purchase information and an encyclopedia entry have also been added
Added indicators in the tutorial showing the next step after pouring beer (Quit button)
Added pallets visualizing the space for kegs near the keg filler
Thank you for all your reports and continued support - it really helps us improve the game! 🍻
See you soon,
Beer Manufacture Simulator Team
